# Fonts

These files are Latin subsets, served with every OpenPFC site and the documentation, so no page calls a
font CDN at runtime. Each is under the SIL Open Font License 1.1.

| File | Family | License |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `newsreader-latin-500-normal.woff2` | Newsreader | SIL OFL 1.1 |
| `newsreader-latin-600-normal.woff2` | Newsreader | SIL OFL 1.1 |
| `outfit-latin-400-normal.woff2` | Outfit | SIL OFL 1.1 |
| `outfit-latin-560-normal.woff2` | Outfit, used here as weight 500 | SIL OFL 1.1 |
| `ibm-plex-mono-latin-400-normal.woff2` | IBM Plex Mono | SIL OFL 1.1 |

Newsreader: Copyright 2020 The Newsreader Project Authors
(github.com/productiontype/newsreader), with Reserved Font Name
"Newsreader".

Outfit: Copyright 2021 The Outfit Project Authors
(github.com/Outfitio/Outfit-Fonts), with Reserved Font Name "Outfit".

IBM Plex Mono: Copyright 2017 IBM Corp., with Reserved Font Name "Plex".

The license text is `OFL.txt` in this directory. These fonts are not
covered by the license of the design system or of the sites that use it.
